verses.sloka: मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीति ।अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः ।। ५.३९.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: maṇiṁ dattvā tataḥ sītā hanumantamathābravīti ।abhijñānamabhijñātametadrāmasya tattvataḥ ।। 5.39.1।।।।

translations.english: Sita gave the jewel to Hanuman and said, "This signet ornament is known to Rama very well".

verses.sloka: मणिं तु दृष्ट्वा रामो वै त्रयाणां संस्मरिष्यति ।वीरो जनन्या मम च राज्ञो दशरथस्य च ।। ५.३९.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: maṇiṁ tu dṛṣṭvā rāmo vai trayāṇāṁ saṁsmariṣyati ।vīro jananyā mama ca rājño daśarathasya ca ।। 5.39.2।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing this jewel,Rama will recall three of us, my mother, myself and the king Dasaratha" (as this was given by her mother at her marriage.)
translations.hindi: इन कृष्ण-नेत्र-वाली जानकीजी का तो दर्शन मिल गया; किन्तु एक छोटा कार्य श्रीर करना रह गया है। सो उसके करने के लिए पहिले तीन उपायों {श्र्थात्‌ साम, दान श्रौर भेद) से तो काम होता देख नहीँ पड़ता । हाँ, चोथे उपाय (अर्थात्‌ दण्ड या बलप्रदर्शन) से काम हो सकता है

verses.sloka: स भूयस्त्वं समुत्साहे चोदितो हरिसत्तम ।अस्मिन् कार्यसमारम्भे प्रचिन्तय यदुत्तरम् ।। ५.३९.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa bhūyastvaṁ samutsāhe codito harisattama ।asmin kāryasamārambhe pracintaya yaduttaram ।। 5.39.3।।।।

translations.english: "Great Hanuman you are enthused now. You may think over the future course of action.
translations.hindi: ये राक्षस बड़े कूर स्वभाव वाले हे--प्रतः खुशामद बरामद से यहाँ काम नहीं निकल सकता । उनके पास धन सम्पत्ति की कमी नहीं; अतः उनको घन सम्पत्ति देने की लालच दिखाना भी व्यर्थ ही है। बलदपित पुरुषों में भेद डाल कर भी काम निकालना कठिन है । भ्रतः शेष कार्य को करने के लिए (दण्डनीति). पराक्रम प्रकाश करना ही मुझे ठीक जान पड़ता है

verses.sloka: त्वमस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम ।हनुमन् यत्नमास्थाय दुःखक्षयकरो भव ।तस्य चिन्तयतो यत्नो दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत् ।। ५.३९.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvamasmin kāryaniryoge pramāṇaṁ harisattama ।hanuman yatnamāsthāya duḥkhakṣayakaro bhava ।tasya cintayato yatno duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet ।। 5.39.4।।।।

translations.english: "O best of monkeys it is your responsibility to carry out this task. O Hanuman think carefully of that. Take the initiative to reduce my suffering. I am confident that you can do it."
translations.hindi: दुसरे के बल की जाँच करने के लिए स्वपराक्रम प्रकट करने के श्रतिरिक्त मुझे अन्य कोई उपाय कार्यसिद्धि करने वाला नहीं देख पड़ता । जब राक्षसों के पक्ष के कतिपय वीर मारे जायेंगे तब संभव है, राक्षस भागे के युद्ध में डीले पड़ जायें

verses.sloka: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः ।शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे ।। ५.३९.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ ।śirasā ' 'vandya vaidehīṁ gamanāyopacakrame ।। 5.39.5।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman possessed with fierce valour said to Vaidehi, 'so be it' and bowed his head, and offered salutations before he departed.
translations.hindi: मुख्य कार्य को प्रथम करके मरौर मुख्य कार्य को हानि न पहुँचाते हुए, जो दूत भ्रोर भी कई एक कायं पूरे कर डाले, तो वही दूत वास्तव मैं कार्य करने फे योग्य कहा जा सकता है

verses.sloka: ज्ञत्वा संप्रस्थितं देवी वानरं मारुतात्मजम् ।बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मैथिली वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: jñatvā saṁprasthitaṁ devī vānaraṁ mārutātmajam ।bāṣpagadgadayā vācā maithilī vākyamabravīt ।। 5.39.6।।।।

translations.english: The noble lady, Sita, having been fully convinced about Hanuman and realising that he is about to start, her voice was choked with tears. She said these words:
translations.hindi: जो व्यक्ति छोटे से किसी एक काम को बड़े प्रयत्न से पूरा करता है, बह कायंसाघक नहीं कहा जा सकता । किन्तु जो सामान्य प्रयास से झपने कार्य को अनेक प्रका से पूरा कर डाले, उसी को कार्य करने के योग्य कहन॥ चाहिए

verses.sloka: कुशलं हनुमन् ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ५.३९.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: kuśalaṁ hanuman brūyāḥ sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 5.39.7।।।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि मैने रब सुग्रीव के समीप जाने ही का निचय कर लिया है तयापि शत्रु के साथ जब मेरा युद्ध होगा तब भ्रपने और शत्र के बलाबल का राक-ठीक विचार कर लूंगा । तदनन्तर यहाँ से चलेगा; तभी तो स्वामी फे झादर्श का यथावत्‌ पालन हो सकेगा

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वाररान् ।ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम् ।। ५.३९.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvaṁ ca sahāmātyaṁ vṛddhān sarvāṁśca vārarān ।brūyāstvaṁ vānaraśreṣṭha kuśalaṁ dharmasaṁhitam ।। 5.39.8।।।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.

verses.sloka: यथा स च महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः ।अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ।। ५.३९.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathā sa ca mahābāhurmāṁ tārayati rāghavaḥ ।asmādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhāttvaṁ samādhātumarhasi ।। 5.39.9।।।।

translations.english: "You must pacify the strongarmed Rama in a manner by which he will help me to cross the ocean of grief and rlieve me.

verses.sloka: जीवन्तीं मां यथा रामः सम्भावयति कीर्तिमान् ।तत्तथा हनुमन् वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि ।। ५.३९.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: jīvantīṁ māṁ yathā rāmaḥ sambhāvayati kīrtimān ।tattathā hanuman vācyaṁ vācā dharmamavāpnuhi ।। 5.39.10।।।।

translations.english: "Let the illustrious Rama take me alive. Help me with your (persuasive) words and you will acquire merit.
translations.hindi: ततः समासाय रणे दशानन समन्त्रिवर्गं सबलप्रयायिनस्‌ । हृदि स्थितं तस्य मतं बलं च वे सुखेन मत्त्वाःहुसित: पुनव्रंजे }। €॥ मन्त्री, सेना तथा भ्रपने सुहूदों के सहित रावण को युद्ध में पाकर श्रभी उसके हृद्गत भावों को तथा उसके बल को ,जान कर मैं फिर सुखपूर्वक यहाँ से रवाना हो जाऊंगा ।। €॥ इदमस्य नृशंसस्य नन्दत्तोपसमुत्तसम्‌ । वनं नेत्रमनःकान्तं नानाद्ुमलतायुत्रम्‌ ?

verses.sloka: नित्यमुत्साहयुक्ताश्च वाचः श्रुत्वा त्वयेरिताः ।वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये ।। ५.३९.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: nityamutsāhayuktāśca vācaḥ śrutvā tvayeritāḥ ।vardhiṣyate dāśaratheḥ pauruṣaṁ madavāptaye ।। 5.39.11।।।।

translations.english: "On hearing your ever spirited words his manliness to get me back will be charged.

verses.sloka: मत्सन्देशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तः श्रुत्वैव राघवः ।पराक्रमविधिं वीरो विधिवत् संविधास्यति ।। ५.३९.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: matsandeśayutā vācastvattaḥ śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ ।parākramavidhiṁ vīro vidhivat saṁvidhāsyati ।। 5.39.12।।।।

translations.english: After hearing my message repeated from you, the heroic Rama will duly make his display of valour.

verses.sloka: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṁ śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।śirasyañjalimādhāya vākyamuttarabravīt ।। 5.39.13।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard Sita's words, Hanuman, son of Maruta, placed his folded palms over his head in reverence and replied:
translations.hindi: तब वह घोड, रथ प्रोर हाथियों सहित, त्रिशूल, खड्ग पटाथारिणी आफ्नी बडी सेना मुझसे लड़ने के लिए भेजेगा । तब बड़ी भारी सुडाई होगी ।॥ १३, ३६४ न्दरकाण्डे ग्रहं तु तैः संयति चण्डविक्रमः | समेत्य रक्षोभिरसह्यविक्रसः । निहत्य तद्रावणचोदितं बलं सुखं गमिष्यामि कपीश्वरालयस्‌

verses.sloka: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हर्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः ।यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीन् शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति ।। ५.३९.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṣiprameṣyati kākutstho haryṛkṣapravarairvṛtaḥ ।yaste yudhi vijityārīn śokaṁ vyapanayiṣyati ।। 5.39.14।।।।

translations.english: "Kakutstha Rama, accompanied by vanaras and bears will reach here soon and conquer the enemies in war and relieve your grief.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर भयंकर विक्रमशाली पवननन्दन हनुमानजी क्रुद्ध हो पवन की. तरह बड़े वेग से भ्रशोकवन के वृक्षों को उखाइने लगे

verses.sloka: नहि पश्यामि मर्त्येषु नासुरेषु सुरेषु वा ।यस्तस्य क्षिपतो बाणान् स्थातुमुत्सहतो ऽग्रतः ।। ५.३९.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: nahi paśyāmi martyeṣu nāsureṣu sureṣu vā ।yastasya kṣipato bāṇān sthātumutsahato 'grataḥ ।। 5.39.15।।।।

translations.english: "I do not see any one among humans or demons or even among gods who can face his arrows when released.

verses.sloka: अप्यर्कमपि पर्जन्यमपि वैवस्वतं यमम् ।सहि सोढुं रणे शक्तस्तव हेतोर्विशेषतः ।। ५.३९.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: apyarkamapi parjanyamapi vaivasvataṁ yamam ।sahi soḍhuṁ raṇe śaktastava hetorviśeṣataḥ ।। 5.39.16।।।।

translations.english: "Indeed, Rama is capable of conquering even the Sungod, or the raingod or Yama (the son of the Sun) specially for your sake.
translations.hindi: तह वन वृक्षों के गिर जाने, जलाशयो के नष्ट हो जाने तथा पर्वतशिखरों के टूट प्न से बहुत ही बुरा देख पड़ने लगा

verses.sloka: स हि सागरपर्यन्तां महीं शासितुमीहते ।त्वन्निमित्तो हि रामस्य जयो जनकनन्दिनि ।। ५.३९.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa hi sāgaraparyantāṁ mahīṁ śāsitumīhate ।tvannimitto hi rāmasya jayo janakanandini ।। 5.39.17।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is fit to rule the entire earth surrounded by the ocean. O delight of Janaka he will succeed in serving your cause."
translations.hindi: प्रकार के जलचर पक्षियों के तितर-बितर हो जाने से. पुष्करिणियों 7 के टूट जाने से, लाल-लाल नवीन पत्तों ona के मुरझाने से तथा लता सहित वृक्षों के क्लान्त हो जाने से

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सत्यं सुभाषितम् ।जानकी बहुमेने ऽथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā samyak satyaṁ subhāṣitam ।jānakī bahumene 'tha vacanaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 5.39.18।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the truthful, proper, pleasing words by Hanuman whom she held in great esteem, Sita said this:
translations.hindi: दावानल के भस्म हुए वन की तरह वह उपवन हो गया । ग्रोड़नी खसकी हुई व्याकुल स्त्रियों की तरह, लताग्रों की दशा हो गई

verses.sloka: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः ।भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत् ।। ५.३९.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastaṁ prasthitaṁ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ ।bhartṛsnehānvitaṁ vākyaṁ sauhārdādanumānayat ।। 5.39.19।।।।

translations.english: Sita again and again looked at Hanuman who was about to start. She made him understand her words conveying her love for Rama.

verses.sloka: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम ।कस्मिंश्चित् संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि ।। ५.३९.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi vā manyase vīra vasaikāhamarindama ।kasmiṁścit saṁvṛte deśe viśrāntaḥ śvo gamiṣyasi ।। 5.39.20।।।।

translations.english: "O destroyer of enemies if you think of halting for a day you may do so in a solitary location and leave tomorrow.
translations.hindi: सा विह्वलाशोकलताप्रताना वनस्थली शोकलताप्रताना । जाता दशास्यप्रमदावनस्य कपेर्वलाद्धि प्रमदावनस्य

verses.sloka: मम चेदल्पभाग्यायाः सान्निध्यात्तव वानर ।अस्य शोकस्य महतो मुहूर्तं मोक्षणं भवेत् ।। ५.३९.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: mama cedalpabhāgyāyāḥ sānnidhyāttava vānara ।asya śokasya mahato muhūrtaṁ mokṣaṇaṁ bhavet ।। 5.39.21।।।।

translations.english: "Your presence will relieve me of my suffering, if you stay here for a while.
translations.hindi: Nanaji 2०० aR EN, hr. An ecangori Initiative महाबलवान हनुमानजी रावण के मन को व्यथा पहुँचाने वाले (अशोकवन | का नाश) काये को कर, अथवा रावण की बड़ी भारी हानि कर झनेक * राक्षसों के साथ युद्ध करने को कामना से, उस बाग के बड़े फाटक के ऊपर जा बेठे

verses.sloka: गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु ।प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः ।। ५.३९.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: gate hi hariśārdūla punarāgamanāya tu ।prāṇānāmapi sandeho mama syānnātra saṁśayaḥ ।। 5.39.22।।।।

translations.english: "O tiger among vanaras if you leave this place to come again, my life will be uncertain, (if your coming is uncertain). There is no doubt about it.

verses.sloka: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत् ।दुःखाद्दुःखपरामृष्टां दीपयन्निव वानर ।। ५.३९.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tavādarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo māṁ paritāpayet ।duḥkhādduḥkhaparāmṛṣṭāṁ dīpayanniva vānara ।। 5.39.23।।।।

translations.english: "My agony would be increased further by not seeing you. It would be inflamming my agony and I would be even more pained.

verses.sloka: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः ।सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर ।। ५.३९.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ ca vīra sandehastiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ ।sumahāṁstvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvara ।। 5.39.24।।।।

translations.english: "O heroic chief of vanaras I am doubtful as to whether vanaras and bears can extend help?

verses.sloka: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम् ।तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ ।। ५.३९.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ nu khalu duṣpāraṁ tariṣyanti mahodadhim ।tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau ।। 5.39.25।।।।

translations.english: "How can the army of vanaras and bears, for that matter, princes Rama and Lakshmana negotiate the ocean, which is difficult to cross?

verses.sloka: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने ।शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा ।। ५.३९.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṁ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane ।śaktiḥ syādvainateyasya tava vā mārutasya vā ।। 5.39.26।।।।

translations.english: "It is only three beings who have the capacity to leap over this ocean. Garuda, or you or the Windgod.

verses.sloka: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे ।किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः ।। ५.३९.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadasmin kāryaniryoge vīraivaṁ duratikrame ।kiṁ paśyasi samādhānaṁ tvaṁ hi kāryavidāṁ varaḥ ।। 5.39.27।।।।

translations.english: "What means do you, being the foremost hero among the three who are capable performing this difficult task, foresee?

verses.sloka: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने ।पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते फलोदयः ।। ५.३९.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane ।paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste phalodayaḥ ।। 5.39.28।।।।

translations.english: "O slayer of enemy heroes if you alone can accomplish this task the fame of doing this will be yours.

verses.sloka: बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां रावणं जित्यसंयुगे ।विजयी स्वपुरीं यायात् तत्तु मे स्याद्यशस्करम् ।। ५.३९.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: balaiḥ samagrairyadi māṁ rāvaṇaṁ jityasaṁyuge ।vijayī svapurīṁ yāyāt tattu me syādyaśaskaram ।। 5.39.29।।।।

translations.english: "It would be worthy of Rama if he with his entire army emerges victorious over Ravana in a battle and takes me to his city.

verses.sloka: शरैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः ।मां येद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ।। ५.३९.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaraistu saṅkulāṁ kṛtvā laṅkāṁ parabalārdanaḥ ।māṁ yedyadi kākutsthastattasya sadṛśaṁ bhavet ।। 5.39.30।।।।

translations.english: "If Kakutstha (Rama), slayer of the enemy army fills the entire Lanka with his arrows and takes me, then his action will be worthy of him.

verses.sloka: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः ।भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ।। ५.३९.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṁ mahātmanaḥ ।bhavedāhavaśūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya ।। 5.39.31।।।।

translations.english: "You may make arrangement in such a manner that, that great self, the hero in war makes his victorious march which is worthy of him."

verses.sloka: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं सहितं हेतुसंहितम् ।निशम्य हनुमान् शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadarthopahitaṁ vākyaṁ sahitaṁ hetusaṁhitam ।niśamya hanumān śeṣaṁ vākyamuttaramabravīt ।। 5.39.32।।।।

translations.english: Having heard the meaningful, courteous and logical words of Sita, Hanuman replied:

verses.sloka: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः ।सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः ।। ५.३९.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṁ varaḥ ।sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ।। 5.39.33।।।।

translations.english: "O Devi the lord of monkeys, Sugriva heads the army of vanaras and bears. He is richly endowed with satvaguna and is determined to accomplish your cause and free you from sorrow.

verses.sloka: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः ।क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः ।। ५.३९.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa vānarasahasrāṇāṁ koṭībhirabhisaṁvṛtaḥ ।kṣiprameṣyati vaidehi rākṣasānāṁ nibarhaṇaḥ ।। 5.39.34।।।।

translations.english: "O Vaidehi Sugriva will reach this place with thousands of crores of vanaras very soon and would kill all the ogres.

verses.sloka: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नास्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।मनस्सङ्कल्पसंपाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः ।। ५.३९.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya vikramasampannāssattvavanto mahābalāḥ ।manassaṅkalpasaṁpātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ ।। 5.39.35।।।।

translations.english: "Valiant, virtuous and powerful vanaras who can leap with the speed of mind are awaiting orders (of Sugriva).

verses.sloka: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः ।न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः ।। ५.३९.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṁ nopari nādhastānna tiryak sajjate gatiḥ ।na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsvamitatejasaḥ ।। 5.39.36।।।।

translations.english: "Their course cannot be impeded either upward, or downward or right or left. They are indeed very brilliant and would never fail in any task.

verses.sloka: असकृत् तैर्महोत्साहैः ससागरधराधरा ।प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः ।। ५.३९.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: asakṛt tairmahotsāhaiḥ sasāgaradharādharā ।pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmirvāyumārgānusāribhiḥ ।। 5.39.37।।।।

translations.english: "They have often circumambulated the earth including its oceans and mountains through the aerial path with great enthusiasm.

verses.sloka: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः ।मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ ।। ५.३९.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ ।mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasannidhau ।। 5.39.38।।।।

translations.english: "The vanaras under Sugriva who move in the forest are more powerful than me or equal to me. None is inferior to me.

verses.sloka: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः ।नहि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः ।। ५.३९.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tāvadiha prāptaḥ kiṁ punaste mahābalāḥ ।nahi prakṛṣṭāḥ preṣyante preṣyante hītare janāḥ ।। 5.39.39।।।।

translations.english: "If I have managed to come here, why not the other powerful ones? The superior leaders are not sent (as messengers). Only ordinary ones like me are.

verses.sloka: तदलं परितापेन देवि शोको व्यपैतु ते ।एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः ।। ५.३९.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadalaṁ paritāpena devi śoko vyapaitu te ।ekotpātena te laṅkāmeṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ ।। 5.39.40।।।।

translations.english: "O noble lady therefore, give up your agony. Enough of your lamentation. The monkey troops will reach this place in one stride.

verses.sloka: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ ।त्वत्सकाशं महासत्त्वौ नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ।। ५.३९.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāvivoditau ।tvatsakāśaṁ mahāsattvau nṛsiṁhāvāgamiṣyataḥ ।। 5.39.41।।।।

translations.english: "Both the valiant Rama and Lakshmana, lions among men, looking brilliant like Sun and Moon will come to you riding on my back.

verses.sloka: तौ हि वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः ।। ५.३९.४२।।।।
verses.transliteration: tau hi vīrau naravarau sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।āgamya nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ sāyakairvidhamiṣyataḥ ।। 5.39.42।।।।

translations.english: "Both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana will come and blow up the city of Lanka with their unfailing arrows.

verses.sloka: सगणं रावणं हत्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः ।त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरं प्रतियास्यति ।। ५.३९.४३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sagaṇaṁ rāvaṇaṁ hatvā rāghavo raghunandanaḥ ।tvāmādāya varārohe svapuraṁ pratiyāsyati ।। 5.39.43।।।।

translations.english: "O beautiful lady Raghava, the delight of the Raghu race would kill Ravana and his kins and return with you to his city৷৷

verses.sloka: तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी ।नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वलन्तिमिवानलम् ।। ५.३९.४४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadāśvasihi bhadraṁ te bhava tvaṁ kālakāṅkṣiṇī ।nacirāddrakṣyase rāmaṁ prajvalantimivānalam ।। 5.39.44।।।।

translations.english: "Therefore, count the days and rest assured. Let it be auspicious to you. You will shortly see Rama burning like fire.

verses.sloka: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रे ऽस्मिन् सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे ।त्वं समेष्यसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी ।। ५.३९.४५।।।।
verses.transliteration: nihate rākṣasendre 'smin saputrāmātyabāndhave ।tvaṁ sameṣyasi rāmeṇa śaśāṅkeneva rohiṇī ।। 5.39.45।।।।

translations.english: "When Ravana is slain, with his sons, ministers and kith and kin, you will reunite with Rama as Rohini unites with the Moon.

verses.sloka: क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं यास्यसि मैथिलि ।रावणं चैव रामेण निहतं द्रक्ष्यसे ऽचिरात् ।। ५.३९.४६।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṣipraṁ tvaṁ devi śokasya pāraṁ yāsyasi maithili ।rāvaṇaṁ caiva rāmeṇa nihataṁ drakṣyase 'cirāt ।। 5.39.46।।।।

translations.english: "O queen Mythili you come to the end of your sorrow and will soon see Ravana killed by Rama".

verses.sloka: एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत् ।। ५.३९.४७।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamāśvāsya vaidehīṁ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।gamanāya matiṁ kṛtvā vaidehīṁ punarabravīt ।। 5.39.47।।।।

translations.english: Having thus consoled Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod resolved to depart. Once again he spoke to Vadehi:

verses.sloka: तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ।लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम्* ।। ५.३९.४८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamarighnaṁ kṛtātmānaṁ kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi rāghavam ।lakṣmaṇaṁ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṁ laṅkādvāramupasthitam* ।। 5.39.48।।।।

translations.english: "Very soon you would see the slayer of foes, who is an accomplished wielder of the bow (Rama) along with Lakshmana at the entrance of Lanka.

verses.sloka: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् ।वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्र द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान् ।। ५.३९.४९।।।।
verses.transliteration: nakhadaṁṣṭrāyudhān vīrān siṁhaśārdūlavikramān ।vānarān vāraṇendrābhān kṣipra drakṣyasi saṅgatān ।। 5.39.49।।।।

translations.english: "You will soon see heroic vanaras whose weapons are their teeth, who are like lion and tiger in their valour. They are (mighty) like wellbred elephants.

verses.sloka: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु ।नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामार्ये यूथान्यनेकशः ।। ५.३९.५०।।।।
verses.transliteration: śailāmbudanikāśānāṁ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu ।nardatāṁ kapimukhyānāmārye yūthānyanekaśaḥ ।। 5.39.50।।।।

translations.english: "O respectable lady you would see many troops of vanara chiefs who resemble clouds hovering on the mountain peaks of Lankaroaring.

verses.sloka: स तु मर्मणि घोरेण ताडितो मन्मथेषुणा ।न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः ।। ५.३९.५१।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu marmaṇi ghoreṇa tāḍito manmatheṣuṇā ।na śarma labhate rāmaḥ siṁhārdita iva dvipaḥ ।। 5.39.51।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is tormented by the dreadful arrows of the god of love pierced into vitals, like an elephant hit by a lion. He has no happiness in life.

verses.sloka: मा रुदो देवि शोकेन मा भूत् ते मनसो ऽप्रियम् ।शचीव पत्या शक्रेण भर्त्रा नाथवती ह्यसि ।। ५.३९.५२।।।।
verses.transliteration: mā rudo devi śokena mā bhūt te manaso 'priyam ।śacīva patyā śakreṇa bhartrā nāthavatī hyasi ।। 5.39.52।।।।

translations.english: "O devi weep no more.Entertain no unpleasant thoughts.You have a great husband, just as Sachi has her lord Indra.

verses.sloka: रामाद् विशिष्टः को ऽन्यो ऽस्ति कश्चित् सौमित्रिणा समः ।अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ ।। ५.३९.५३।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmād viśiṣṭaḥ ko 'nyo 'sti kaścit saumitriṇā samaḥ ।agnimārutakalpau tau bhrātarau tava saṁśrayau ।। 5.39.53।।।।

translations.english: "Who is superior to Rama? Who is equal to Lakshmana? Both the brothers are like Fire and Wind. They are your refuge.

verses.sloka: नास्मिंश्चिरं वत्स्यसि देवि देशे रक्षोगणैरध्युषिते ऽतिरौद्रे ।न ते चिरादागमनं प्रियस्य क्षमस्व मत्सङ्गमकालमात्रम् ।। ५.३९.५४।।
verses.transliteration: nāsmiṁściraṁ vatsyasi devi deśe rakṣogaṇairadhyuṣite 'tiraudre ।na te cirādāgamanaṁ priyasya kṣamasva matsaṅgamakālamātram ।। 5.39.54।।

translations.english: "O noble lady You will not stay longer in this country, which is a strong hold of hosts of demons and a dreadful place It will not be very long before you unite with your beloved. Pray, have patience till then. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
